title: Fit private graph corrections sequentially after learning a competent shared backbone
one_extension: Learn a full native backbone with ordinary supervision, freeze its selected deterministic function, then fit four full private nonlinear graph residual paths in fixed order against the residual of the served probability pool, while retaining each member's own CE.
motivation_and_boundaries: Amazon saved selected VALID banks have weaker shared mean members and less pooling benefit; 93.60% of shared pooled errors were wrong in every member. This motivates competence plus common-error repair, not arbitrary disagreement.

The later frozen Amazon G0 correction lost to the single, independent4 and ordinary shared references. Graph-free had identical accuracy. Its accuracy hypothesis is closed; this proposal adds no response allocation, Q hypergradient, graph-affinity weight or continuation of that recipe.

Citeseer E_joint common strict errors are 74.74% of pooled strict errors, versus 45.23% for J4_joint. E_live has more disagreement and poorer competence. These observations do not establish graph-information erasure, sharing causality or gradient conflict.

Keeping old states frozen removes a particular correction-stage pathway by which later shared or earlier-branch updates could overwrite earlier functions. It cannot repair a poor common representation by itself, guarantee good private paths, or prove that this pathway caused the saved failures.

architecture.first_concrete_native_target: Prospective WikiCS split0, native Polynormer-r, 11701 nodes, 300 features, 10 classes, hidden512/heads1. This is development on the existing official graph, not fresh-task confirmation.
architecture.learned_base: One complete native local100/global1000 acquisition with the already source-defined ordinary CE, optimizer, graph, dropout and author VALID selector. Preserve the selected mode flag. Expose the selected predictor's actual pre-classifier hidden H0 and logits z0 through a reviewed interface; do not replace its nonlinear learner by a linear probe.
architecture.shared_correction_state: Set the entire selected base, including normalization statistics and dropout, to its deterministic serving mode; freeze its parameters. H0,z0 may be cached once on the full public graph after paying the forward and cache bill. No label is an input to a private branch.
architecture.member_input: u_m(v)=H0(v)+V_m x_v+b_m, with independently owned full 300-to-512 affine V_m,b_m. Use the original prepared support and raw source features.
architecture.private_graph_operation: One complete width512 native local Polynormer block B_m(u_m,A): private GATConv messages with the original edge/self-loop convention, full root linear map, full h linear map, ReLU/dropout, multiplicative h*x interaction, native trainable beta and LayerNorm. Every matrix, attention vector, gate and normalization affine parameter in this block is private.
architecture.private_logit_residual: r_m(v)=U_m B_m(u_m,A)_v+c_m, with full 512-to-10 head. Member logits z_m=z0+r_m; member probabilities p_m=softmax(z_m); serve Q=(p_1+p_2+p_3+p_4)/4.
architecture.raw_information_reason: Raw x and the support graph allow new private messages to separate distinctions that a head receiving only identical H0 cannot separate. This is a conditional opportunity; no actual H0 collision or erased target information has been diagnosed. All capable controls receive the same information.
architecture.relation_to_full_native_private_heads: The existing shared encoder/four native NCN heads control is graph-aware through its native CN readouts, but does not independently propagate raw node features and H0 through a new GAT/root/gated node-state block. This extension changes neighborhood computation before readout, and pays additional message passes.
architecture.relation_to_last_block_untying: The saved last-local-block proposal removes a tied existing block and learns its private replacements. Here the already learned full backbone remains intact and frozen, with new parallel graph correction paths and a staged served-residual objective. This is not a new branching principle.
architecture.initialization: Construct each V_m and native block from an isolated independently seeded ordinary native initializer. Set U_m and c_m exactly to zero. In real arithmetic all initial members and the initial pool reproduce p0 exactly. Source/runtime checks must verify the actual native FP32 equality, disjoint storage and complete state/mode preservation.
architecture.initial_gradient_limit: Zero output weights initially give zero gradients to the new incoming/message parameters. The output head learns first; incoming gradients can appear afterward. There is no immediate incoming-gradient or competence theorem. This is different from the zero-incoming/nonzero-outgoing GradMax growth construction.
architecture.structural_delta: Fixed full private message blocks with raw-feature access; no rank2 bottleneck, SVD initialization, graph-band residual filter, growth into an existing aggregation layer or graph-correlated supervision weights.
architecture.additional_work: One shared native serving trajectory plus four additional native local message blocks. No fast inference or low memory claim. All new message, parameter, gradient, optimizer, snapshot and cache costs must be counted.

staged_fitting.fixed_order: 1,2,3,4; derive private seeds as base_seed+1009*m. Freeze this order and the seed mapping before scores; do not choose an ordering from validation errors.
staged_fitting.epochs: 100 complete ordinary correction epochs per stage. All four stages run; no validation-selected branch stopping, stage discard, coefficient search or joint polishing.
staged_fitting.peers: Previously fitted members remain frozen; future members are their unchanged native-base copies. The final denominator stays4 at every stage. Peers use deterministic serving probabilities while the current path uses its ordinary training dropout.
staged_fitting.loss: For active member m: J_m=mean_TRAIN[ CE(y,p_m) + (M/2)*||Q_m-y_onehot||_2^2 ], Q_m=(sum_{j!=m}p_j_detached+p_m)/M. The current member is live in Q_m. Each node has the same fixed supervision weight. For M4 the Brier coefficient is2.
staged_fitting.why_this_is_residual_fitting: The pool equals p0+(1/M)*sum_j(p_j-p0). The derivative of the Brier term with respect to the active probability vector is Q_m-y_onehot. Its negative is the currently uncorrected served probability residual, rather than a direction chosen to repel another member. It is recomputed from TRAIN and the current active path each epoch.
staged_fitting.equivalent_probability_target: With fixed peers, the Brier term is (1/(2M))*||p_m-t_m||^2, t_m=M*y_onehot-sum_{j!=m}p_j. t_m can leave the probability simplex. Do not clip it, assert exact interpolation, or broadcast this label-derived target to unlabelled graph neighbors.
staged_fitting.logit_gradient: Let J(p)=diag(p)-p p^T. The active per-node logit gradient is (p_m-y_onehot)+J(p_m)*(Q_m-y_onehot). No Hessian target, external teacher, virtual private update, responsibility solver or shared hypergradient is used.
staged_fitting.own_CE_and_nullification: At the initial all-copy state, write v=p0-y_onehot. The logit gradient is v+J(p0)v, and v^T[v+J(p0)v]=||v||^2+v^TJ(p0)v>0 whenever v!=0 because the softmax Jacobian is positive semidefinite. Thus own CE cannot cancel the first-stage correction in logit space; it also supplies a non-saturating wrong-class loss gradient. This is not a parameter-gradient alignment theorem.
staged_fitting.later_conflict: After peers change, own CE can oppose the pool term, or fit the same remaining mistakes as every prior path. Competence pressure may therefore nullify useful residual specialization. No guarantee is claimed. Retain TRAIN gradient norms/cosines of the two terms, per-stage probability residual reduction, complete served error flows and member quality; failed quality cannot be rescued by these diagnostics.
staged_fitting.optimizer: Fresh separate native Adam for each previously untrained private path, lr0.001, wd0 and native betas/eps/default implementation. Only that path receives an update at its stage. The learned base and other paths have no active correction-stage optimizer or gradient state.
staged_fitting.teacher_free_boundary: The current learned base is an initialization and feature source. Targets are ordinary ground-truth TRAIN labels and the current pool residual; there is no separate teacher fit or distillation target. This does not make functional boosting novel.

required_controls.correction: 4 ordered paths *100 epochs; own CE plus served Brier residual

required_controls.role: Same paths, information, initialization and objective; isolate sequential freezing
required_controls.acquisition: The same selected native base may be reused and its acquisition cost charged
required_controls.correction: 100 bank epochs. From each common pre-update bank state, compute each path's gradient of the literal candidate J_m using that path's live dropout output and all other paths' detached deterministic serving outputs; apply all four separately owned Adam updates after the four gradients are obtained. Each path gets100 full-node updates, the same loss normalization/LR/Adam eps as the candidate, and an isolated route stream. This is interleaved coupled fitting, rather than100 consecutive updates with permanently frozen peers. At dropout-free states these per-path gradients equal the gradients of sum_m CE_m +2*Brier(Q); mean CE+2*Brier would overweight the pool by4 and must not be used.

required_controls.role: Same stages/paths/information with ordinary competent member fitting; isolate the served-residual term
required_controls.correction: 4 ordered paths *100 epochs with own CE only, identical optimizer/LR and fixed probability pool

required_controls.role: Full nonlinear native single with ample ordinary optimization
required_controls.acquisition: Native1500 total: local100/global1400, same source selector preserved across the entire trajectory
required_controls.correction: The extra400 full-native epochs continue live end-global weights and Adam history. Retain the best native checkpoint from the original1100 as an eligible state; no forced reset from a warm copy.

required_controls.role: One capable predictor with the same total four-path message budget and all candidate information
required_controls.correction: Four width512 native graph residual paths,100 epochs each in100 joint epochs. Concatenate all four512-dimensional outputs and use a full nonlinear2048-to-512-to-10 readout, added to z0 and zero-output initialized. Train the full predictor with own CE plus2*Brier of its one served probability vector. Permit the full native base to remain trainable; preserve source-mode semantics and optimizer history for existing weights. The extra dense readout/backbone work is disclosed and paid. This single is neither a diagonal head nor one path of a four-path budget.

required_controls.acquisition: 4 separate fresh native constructors, base_seed+1009*m, independent full local100/global1100 fits (1200 each)
required_controls.correction: Each model has its own Adam, native own CE, dropout stream, source transition and source best-VALID selector. No warm donor copies, pooled loss, pooled checkpoint selection or coupled updates. Pool the four fixed selected probability vectors only after their independent fits. All four complete fits are charged.

required_controls.role: Same-operation untied4; isolate any quality value of retaining a common learned backbone
required_controls.acquisition: 4 separate native1100 donors with genuine independent initializations/optimizers/selectors
required_controls.correction: Freeze each independently acquired backbone, supply its own raw x/H0/z0 to one same private path, and run the identical4*100 staged own/pool objective. This coupled correction arm is not called ordinary independent4; its full four-donor bill is charged.

control_contract: Candidate, E_joint and E_own use identical path architectures, initial draws, public graph, TRAIN label exposure and total400 private path updates. Shared base caching and peer probability caching are allowed only under exact dropout/mode/state semantics and are charged.

S_paths sees every candidate message path and feature; its larger nonlinear readout and live backbone intentionally prevent a weak single comparison. Report its extra parameters/graph work separately.

Native single and I_native retain the complete native nonlinear learner and competent source schedules, not reduced heads or identically warmed copies. Existing anchors can be reused only if masks, preprocessing, modes, native selectors, seed histories, full budget and cost custody match exactly.

The ordinary source GNNM4 from the existing WikiCS six-arm study is a useful contextual reference if its eventual contract matches. It cannot replace E_joint, S_paths or true independently acquired I_native.
No neuron-rank, branch-depth, objective-weight, order, LR, checkpoint or dropout search is included. No current queue, dataset artifact, method ledger or plan is modified by this document.

prospective_validation_decision.population: Full official WikiCS split0 VALID union stopping mask,5274 nodes; TRAIN580. Seeds17,29,43. No TEST label read. These shared graph/mask seed replications are development and are not independent graph replications.
prospective_validation_decision.selection: Retain source-native best-VALID selectors during native acquisitions exactly as declared. Every changed residual predictor is assessed at its fixed final correction endpoint. No stagewise validation selection. Freeze every final model/probability artifact before the once-only comparative endpoint analysis; source acquisition selection already used VALID and remains explicit.
prospective_validation_decision.primary: Complete served accuracy; no subgroup can substitute. Proposed minimal useful mean gain is0.5 percentage points versus the strongest of S_continue,S_paths,I_native,E_joint,E_own. Mean gains versus every required quality reference must be positive and every paired-seed gain versus each must be strictly positive. The0.5pp threshold is a prospective practical choice, not a significance claim.
prospective_validation_decision.competence_and_loss: Require candidate mean member accuracy no more than0.25pp below I_native's mean member accuracy; also no candidate member loses more than1.0pp from its own frozen native donor on the complete VALID population. Require mean served NLL not worse than each of S_continue,S_paths,I_native. Report every seed/member accuracy,NLL and Brier. These fixed tolerances are proposed before any outcome; own CE is not a competence certificate.
prospective_validation_decision.staging_attribution: A nonpositive mean gain or any paired-seed nonpositive gain versus E_joint closes the sequential-freezing explanation. The analogous failure versus E_own closes the served-residual addition explanation, even if extra private capacity helps.
prospective_validation_decision.sharing_attribution: A nonpositive mean gain or any paired-seed nonpositive gain versus U_stage leaves no demonstrated quality value of the common frozen backbone. At most report its measured storage/compute tradeoff; do not claim sharing-specific accuracy superiority.
prospective_validation_decision.error_analysis: Before endpoint predictions, define donor-pool baseline error cohorts and class/degree supports. Report donor pool wrong->candidate correct repairs, correct->wrong introduced errors, wrong->different-wrong churn, and the same flows on the donor all-members-wrong/common-competitor cohort. All four candidate members initially equal p0; common-error support is therefore the native donor error cohort, not four independent observations. Retain paired probability loss/confidence changes.
prospective_validation_decision.no_go: Missing/failed/capped required cell, no complete served quality gain, calibration-only improvement, lower common overlap with worse member competence, or S_paths/I_native matching the useful gain stops promotion of this extension. Do not change the architecture, residual coefficient, order or endpoint after a failed complete comparison.
prospective_validation_decision.confirmation: A positive development screen only warrants a separately frozen, unused confirmation population or fresh graph/task before a predictive claim. It is not permission to open TEST here or infer statistical significance from three dependent seed comparisons.

engineering_and_cost_limits: This note defines operations but contains no implementation, model import/forward/backward, field generation, numerical diagnostic, dataset load, remote access or launch.

Before any fit, qualify exact native-base inclusion, final-mode/state preservation, path storage ownership, first output-head and later incoming gradient connectivity, autograd expression for J_m, frozen-peer/base restoration, cache purity, and finite TRAIN-only native costs. These proposed checks have not been run.

For candidate count1 native1100 acquisition,1 selected cache forward,400 one-block gradient epochs, all peer serving/cache refreshes, snapshot and validation costs. E_joint has400 path gradient epochs; S_paths has400 residual path epochs plus100 full native passes and its extra nonlinear readout. I_native has4 native1200 acquisitions. U_stage has4 native1100 acquisitions plus400 path epochs.

No time, memory or practical compute advantage has been measured. Do not transfer current low-rank growth, graph-weight or full-native-head resource qualification to this changed architecture. Actual complete-cost qualification and finite allocation remain root responsibilities.

prior_and_novelty.grownet: Direct ancestry for sequential neural residual fitting, raw-feature plus previous hidden-state inputs, and the possibility that joint corrective fitting is superior to permanent freezing. This candidate uses a fixed probability pool/Brier correction and own competent predictors, not GrowNet's scalar additive/Newton weak-learner objective.
prior_and_novelty.boostresnet: Direct ancestry for stagewise learning of full residual representation blocks. Its auxiliary classifiers telescope into one final ResNet, so sequential residual learning supplies no ensemble necessity. Its bounded-hypothesis/weak-edge/covariance assumptions and iid setup do not establish this graph method's competence or quality.
prior_and_novelty.reused_priors: AdaGCN, BGNN and B3F-GNN already establish graph boosting/error specialization; TreeNets/CAMERO establish shared early/private late processing. Correct-and-Smooth establishes graph residual correction. Full private heads, private-last-block untying and graph-error low-rank growth are already retained local alternatives.
prior_and_novelty.remaining_local_hypothesis: Stable learned common features plus full raw-feature graph residual computation, learned by staged served residual fitting with own competence pressure, may repair common mistakes under the declared finite budget. Its complete published overlap is unexcluded. This is a local utility hypothesis, not novelty clearance or a new learning principle.
